# Block `code`

**Use:** A code or query example from the material. Set `run` only for SQL, Cypher or Gremlin that the site can execute.

**Avoid:** Pseudo-code that is really a sequence of steps — use steps.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "code",
  "lang": "python",
  "code": "def mean(values):\n    return sum(values) / len(values)",
  "caption": "The arithmetic mean.",
  "run": false,
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"code"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `lang` | string | yes |
| `code` | string | yes |
| `caption` | string | no |
| `run` | object \| `false` | no |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
